rule: A broker position is TB-owned ONLY through explicit identity evidence: magic number == 31082026 AND (comment carries the TB basket token, OR a persisted LEG_FILL_CONFIRMED event recorded its position ticket).

cases.position: magic=31082026, no comment, no persisted linkage

cases.classification: UNKNOWN_POSITION, never altered, never blocks TB engine

no_blind_flatten: The engine may never flatten unrelated user positions; ambiguous ownership => BLOCK (no action).
unknown_positions: Reported in reconciliation output as UNKNOWN:<ticket> with action=NONE and blocked=false (off-limits, not the TB engine's problem).
magic_number: 31082026 preserved (execution-contract versioning may change it later, not here).
